subject: Question about retroactive usage adjustment and VAT breakdown
messages:
From: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@zenflow.ai>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@zenflow.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected retroactive charge on INV-2027-09-12 - need breakdown

Hi Jordan,

We noticed a line on invoice INV-2027-09-12 titled 'retroactive usage adjustment (usage_rollback)' for EUR 3,200. This charge pushed our September bill significantly higher and appears to be applied after the billing cycle closed. Can you help us understand: 

- What triggered the retroactive adjustment (service, date range, and technical root cause)?
- A per-day breakdown of the additional tokens charged and which model/route generated them (streaming vs. embeddings).
- Whether VAT was applied to the charge correctly for our EU entity and, if not, a VAT-exclusive breakdown for reclaiming purposes.

We need logs and any evidence for our procurement and tax teams to approve the payment hold. Month-end is approaching on our side and we are escalating this internally. Please loop in billing ops and your manager if needed.

Thanks,
Claire Brooks
Head of Platform Procurement
ZenFlow Inc.
[Attachment: invoice-INV-2027-09-12.pdf (PDF, 92KB)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@zenflow.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected retroactive charge on INV-2027-09-12 - need breakdown

Hi Claire — thanks for flagging and sorry for the surprise. I'm escalating this to our billing operations team (cc Ben) and copying my manager Marissa so we can turn around a full packet for your procurement and VAT team.

Ben: can you confirm the cause and attach the usage traces and token-level export for the affected window? Claire specifically asked for per-day token counts and VAT treatment. If this is a post-cycle correction on our side we should propose a provisional remediation (credit or voucher) while the full reconciliation runs.

Claire — we'll aim to get an initial breakdown within 24 hours and a formal credit note within 72 hours. If you need a faster provisional note for your AP team, let us know and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0102
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@zenflow.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected retroactive charge on INV-2027-09-12 - need breakdown

Hi all — short summary and attachments included.

What happened (short): During an internal sampling correction deployed on 2027-08-30 we discovered a small subset of sessions ingested with duplicate request IDs across a replay endpoint. When we backfilled to correct attribution we identified ~1.1M tokens that had been under-attributed in the Aug 1–7 window. The billing system marked those as a post-cycle 'usage_rollback' adjustment and generated a retro charge for the delta.

What I'm attaching: a token-level export (usage-trace-zenflow-aug1-7.csv) with columns: date, request_id, model, route, tokens_request, tokens_response, prior_attribution, corrected_attribution. Also attaching a short sampling-evidence text file.

Quick evidence snippet (excerpt):
2027-08-02T14:03:11Z, req_9f3b, gptj-3.8, /generate, 122, 410, 0, 532
2027-08-04T09:21:04Z, req_4a2d, embed-384, /embed, 0, 512, 0, 512

Why VAT looks higher: We rebilled the usage into the September invoice because the correction was detected after the Aug close and our system applies VAT at the time of invoicing for EU entities (per our tax settings). That made the visible charge larger on the September invoice. We should have surfaced a provisional notice at the time of correction — that's on us.

Proposed immediate remediation:
- Issue a provisional credit voucher for EUR 3,200 to offset the retro charge while we finish reconciliation (attached provisional-credit-voucher-zenflow.txt).
- Provide a VAT-exclusive breakdown and a formal credit note (CR-2027-278.pdf) within 48 business hours.
- Root-cause: duplicate request_id replay from internal replay job; engineering has patched the ingestion rule to dedupe at collector stage to prevent recurrence.

Next steps: Jordan, can you confirm Claire that we will apply a provisional credit and expedite the credit note? Claire, if ZenFlow needs the credit note in a specific format for VAT reclaim please send the template.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: usage-trace-zenflow-aug1-7.csv (CSV, 42KB)]
[Attachment: provisional-credit-voucher-zenflow.txt (TXT, 1KB)]
From: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@zenflow.ai>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Cc: vat@zenflow.ai, procure@zenflow.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 17:02:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected retroactive charge on INV-2027-09-12 - need breakdown

Thanks Ben — that explanation helps. A couple of follow-ups from our tax team (copied):

- We need an explicit VAT breakdown for the EUR 3,200: base amount, VAT rate applied, VAT amount, and the invoice references where the VAT was posted. Our EU entity requires the credit note to show the VAT-exclusive base to process the reclaim.
- Please confirm whether the provisional credit voucher will be applied to our account balance immediately or only once the formal credit note is issued. We prefer immediate application so AP can release the payment hold for the remainder of the invoice.

Also — for audit evidence the tax folks want the exact date range and the list of request_ids (or a sample) showing corrected attribution. The CSV is a good start; would prefer a per-day aggregation as well (CSV or simple table).

Appreciate the quick turn. If you can apply the provisional credit today and confirm, our AP team will move forward on the invoice.

Claire Brooks
Head of Platform Procurement
ZenFlow Inc.
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Brooks <claire.brooks@zenflow.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vat@zenflow.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 17:15:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Unexpected retroactive charge on INV-2027-09-12 - need breakdown

Claire — confirmed. We've applied a provisional credit of EUR 3,200 to your account balance effective immediately; it should show up in the billing portal within the hour (link below). Ben's team will deliver the VAT-exclusive breakdown and the formal credit note (CR-2027-278.pdf) by end of day tomorrow.

Action items / owners:
- Ben Carter (Billing Ops): deliver per-day aggregation CSV + formal credit note (48h).
- Marissa Cole (Sales Manager): follow up on escalation and confirm no operational impact to ZenFlow's service.
- Jordan Blake (AE): confirm on portal once credit is visible and provide any AP-facing language needed.

Portal: https://console.redwood.ai/billing/invoices/INV-2027-09-12

If you need anything else to unblock payment, call me directly and I'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: CR-2027-278.pdf (PDF, 18KB) - provisional credit note]
